tool.title: Moorkyz Toolbar Builder
tool.summary: Design, preview and export a tiny toolbar. A few links, a little style, one HTML file.
tool.catalogDescription: Design, preview and export a tiny toolbar that feels at home on your next page. Arrange up to eight links, try light or dark styling, choose an accent and pin the result to the top or bottom. Watch the preview change as you edit, then take away one self-contained HTML file. No framework, package installation or account stands between your idea and a useful little navigation bar.
tool.description: A compact browser-only builder for up to eight navigation links. Pick light or dark appearance, an accent border and top or bottom placement, then copy or download one self-contained HTML file. No package, framework, account or service required.
useCases: Make a small navigation bar for a landing page or local utility.
Try link labels and appearance without setting up a development project.
Take portable, readable HTML/CSS with no JavaScript or runtime dependencies.

setup.title: Edit the links
setup.text: Use the small builder above. Set labels and #section, /local-path or HTTP(S) destinations.

setup.title: Copy or download
setup.text: Open the HTML directly, or copy its nav and CSS into your own page. Generated output is at most 8 KiB; no installation is needed.
